name: When should I call a professional for a grease clog?

mainEntity.name: When should I call a professional for a grease clog?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should call a professional for a grease clog if you notice persistent slow drains, foul odors, gurgling sounds, or if water is backing up in your sinks, especially after attempting to clear it yourself without success. Ignoring these signs can lead to complete blockages, burst pipes, or significant water damage, requiring more extensive and costly repairs. Early intervention by experts like CG Plumbing Solutions can prevent these severe issues and protect your plumbing infrastructure.
acceptedAnswer.description: Call a professional for persistent slow drains, foul odors, or water backups from grease clogs to prevent severe plumbing damage.
